bodies.name: Islamic Food and Nutrition Council of America
bodies.certificate_number_hint: Document number in the form `MAR 23823 23824 250001 US`, with the Crescent-M mark
bodies.notes: Product search is a web form with no API. ANSI accreditation covers cosmetics and halal personal care. Recognition rows must be re-verified against the JAKIM gazette and the BPJPH LHLN list, which both expire and are periodically withdrawn.

bodies.name: Halal Certification Europe
bodies.certificate_number_hint: Certificate number in the form `21633-1/2/2/Y1` with issue and expiry dates and a product annex
bodies.notes: UK body that explicitly certifies cosmetics. No public searchable register was found, so verification is certificate-by-certificate. Recognition claims are published by HCE itself and must be confirmed against each regulator's current list.

bodies.name: Halal Food Authority
bodies.certificate_number_hint: HFA registered mark plus a contractual certificate; no public verification portal
bodies.notes: Certifies cosmetics, chemicals and aromas alongside food. Maintains an internal approved-manufacturer list that is not published as open data, so claims can only reach the document-checked rung.

bodies.name: Halal Monitoring Committee
bodies.certificate_number_hint: Annual certificate plus HMC labels; premises carry a numbered sticker
bodies.notes: Certifies non-meat consumables including cosmetics. The public directory lists premises rather than products. HMC states explicitly that it does not verify water-permeability claims, so an HMC certificate says nothing about ablution suitability.

bodies.name: LPPOM MUI (Indonesian Council of Ulama assessment institute)
bodies.certificate_number_hint: Legacy MUI certificate numbers; since October 2019 LPPOM acts as an inspection body and BPJPH issues the certificate
bodies.notes: Authority to issue Indonesian halal certificates moved to BPJPH in October 2019 under Law 33/2014. LPPOM MUI is now a halal inspection body and MUI retains the fatwa role. Legacy certificates remain valid until expiry, so both must be modelled.

bodies.name: Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Produk Halal
bodies.certificate_number_hint: BPJPH halal certificate plus the Indonesian halal label; foreign certificates need SHLN registration under Decree 221/2025
bodies.notes: The Indonesian regulator. Its public `cek halal` product search is the strongest verification surface available for Indonesian-market products, and its LHLN list records which foreign bodies are recognised per scope. Cosmetics fall under the mandatory certification deadline of 17 October 2026.

bodies.name: Jabatan Kemajuan Islam Malaysia
bodies.certificate_number_hint: Sijil Pengesahan Halal Malaysia (SPHM) number, verifiable by QR through the Verify Halal app
bodies.notes: Malaysian regulator. Its MYeHALAL portal verifies certificates under the category `Kosmetik dan Dandanan Diri`, and it gazettes recognised foreign bodies for two-year terms. MS 2634:2019 is the current Malaysian halal cosmetics standard, replacing MS 2200-1:2008.

bodies.name: Australian Federation of Islamic Councils
bodies.certificate_number_hint: Site certification; certificate identifiers are not published for cosmetics
bodies.notes: AFIC's published certification programme is site-based and oriented to food and slaughter. Cosmetics scope could not be confirmed from its own pages, so the register deliberately records no beauty scope. A cosmetics claim naming AFIC therefore resolves to `certifier does not cover cosmetics` until that is evidenced, which is the honest outcome.

bodies.name: Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology, UAE
bodies.certificate_number_hint: UAE Halal National Mark; product certificates are issued by MOIAT-registered bodies, not by the ministry
bodies.notes: Successor to ESMA for the UAE halal programme. GSO 2055-4:2021 / UAE.S 2055-4 is the cosmetics and personal care halal standard. MOIAT registers certification bodies with scope letters, where scope N is cosmetics.

bodies.name: Halal Accreditation Agency (Helal Akreditasyon Kurumu)
bodies.certificate_number_hint: Accreditation numbers such as `2019-001`; HAK does not issue product certificates
bodies.notes: An accreditation body, not a certification body. A product claiming to be `HAK certified` is misdescribed: the certificate must come from a HAK-accredited body, whose scope may include OIC/SMIIC 4:2018 for cosmetics. Modelled with no product scopes so that such claims fail the scope check by design.
